nodes.text: Open your own Khaz Algar Engineering recipes and select Invent.

recovery.text: If the recipe is missing, switch expansion tiers and clear recipe filters. Skill level alone does not prove the recipe is learned.

Open your own Khaz Algar Engineering recipes and select Invent.

nodes.text: Craft Invent when its observed cooldown is ready. Gather the listed materials and tools first; use the in-game Craft button yourself.
nodes.details:
Open your own Khaz Algar Engineering recipes.
Craft Invent when available. Materials: 25 Piles of Rusted Scrap. Tools: Arclight Spanner, Gyromatic Micro-Adjustor, Tinker’s Workbench.
